entries.title: Revelation of John 19:1
segments: ¶After these things I heard as a loud voice of a great multitude in the heaven, saying, Hallelujah: the salvation and the glory and the power of our God:

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:2
segments: for true and righteous [are] his judgments; for he has judged the great harlot which corrupted the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his bondmen at her hand.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:3
segments: And a second time they said, Hallelujah. And her smoke goes up to the ages of ages.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:4
segments: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and did homage to God who sits upon the throne, saying, Amen, Hallelujah.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:5
segments: ¶And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his bondmen, [and] ye that fear him, small and great.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:6
segments: And I heard as a voice of a great crowd, and as a voice of many waters, and as a voice of strong thunders, saying, Hallelujah, for [the] Lord our God the Almighty has taken to himself kingly power.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:7
segments: Let us rejoice and exult, and give him glory; for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:8
segments: And it was given to her that she should be clothed in fine linen, bright [and] pure; for the fine linen is the righteousnesses of the saints.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:9
segments: And he says to me, Write, Blessed [are] they who are called to the supper of the marriage of the Lamb. And he says to me, These are the true words of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:10
segments: And I fell before his feet to do him homage. And he says to me, See [thou do it] not. I am thy fellow-bondman, and [the fellow-bondman] of thy brethren who have the testimony of Jesus. Do homage to God. For the spirit of prophecy is the testimony of Jesus.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:11
segments: ¶And I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and one sitting on it, [called] Faithful and True, and he judges and makes war in righteousness.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:12
segments: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and upon his head many diadems, having a name written which no one knows but himself;

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:13
segments: and [he is] clothed with a garment dipped in blood; and his name is called The Word of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:14
segments: And the armies which [are] in the heaven followed him upon white horses, clad in white, pure, fine linen.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:15
segments: And out of his mouth goes a sharp [two-edged] sword, that with it he might smite the nations; and he shall shepherd them with an iron rod; and he treads the wine-press of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:16
segments: And he has upon his garment, and upon his thigh, a name written, King of kings, and Lord of lords.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:17
segments: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid-heaven, Come, gather yourselves to the great supper of God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:18
segments: that ye may eat flesh of kings, and flesh of chiliarchs, and flesh of strong men, and flesh of horses and of those that sit upon them, and flesh of all, both free and bond, and small and great.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:19
segments: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to make war against him that sat upon the horse, and against his army.

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:20
segments: And the beast was taken, and the false prophet that [was] with him, who wrought the signs before him by which he deceived them that received the mark of the beast, and those that worship his image. Alive were both cast into the lake of fire which burns with brimstone;

entries.title: Revelation of John 19:21
segments: and the rest were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which goes out of his mouth; and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
